list_child.name: lsSeasonRuns
list_child.desc: Returns every show run currently on the company's season calendar, across every phase from rehearsal through closing. Use this when planning dates and venues for the season.

decoys.name: lsTouringRuns
decoys.desc: Returns every show run currently on the company's touring itinerary, across every phase from rehearsal through closing. Use this when booking trucks and hotels for the road company.

decoys.name: lsSubscriptionRuns
decoys.desc: Returns every show run currently in the company's subscriber package, across every phase from rehearsal through closing. Use this when the box office renews season ticket holders.

decoys.name: lsGrantRuns
decoys.desc: Returns every show run currently in the company's arts council grant report, across every phase from rehearsal through closing. Use this when the development office prepares funding reports.

get_child.name: getRunBooking
get_child.desc: Retrieves the booking record of a single show run by its unique identifier, including its current phase and scheduling details. Stage management uses this when confirming dates for one production.

decoys.name: getRunCallsheet
decoys.desc: Retrieves the call sheet of a single show run by its unique identifier, including crew call times and rehearsal calls. Stage management uses this when posting the daily schedule for one production.

decoys.name: getRunRider
decoys.desc: Retrieves the technical rider of a single show run by its unique identifier, including lighting, sound, and rigging needs. Stage management uses this when preparing the venue for one production.

decoys.name: getRunGrosses
decoys.desc: Retrieves the box office grosses of a single show run by its unique identifier, including tickets sold and house capacity. Stage management uses this when estimating the house for one production.

list_parent.name: lsSlateProducers
list_parent.desc: Returns every producer on the company's producing slate, along with the name on file for each. Useful when assembling the season's list of credited producers.

decoys.name: lsCoproProducers
decoys.desc: Returns every producer on the company's co-production partner list, along with the name on file for each. Useful when looking for partners to share a production's costs.

decoys.name: lsFestivalProducers
decoys.desc: Returns every producer on the company's festival circuit contacts, along with the name on file for each. Useful when submitting a show to summer festivals.

decoys.name: lsBoardProducers
decoys.desc: Returns every producer on the company's board of directors, along with the name on file for each. Useful when preparing the agenda for a board meeting.

get_parent.name: getProducerProfile
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single producer's profile by id, including the name on file. The general manager uses this when confirming who a producer is.

decoys.name: getProducerContract
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single producer's contract by id, including royalty terms and fees. The general manager uses this when checking a producer's deal.

decoys.name: getProducerBilling
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single producer's billing credit by id, including its wording and size. The general manager uses this when approving posters and programs.

decoys.name: getProducerReps
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single producer's representation by id, including the agent and attorney on file. The general manager uses this when sending contracts out.

delete_child.name: pullRun
delete_child.desc: Permanently strikes a show run from the company's schedule, removing all record of its booking. This action cannot be undone once submitted, so it should be used with care.

decoys.name: voidTickets
decoys.desc: Permanently voids every ticket sold for a show run, refunding all patrons through the box office. This action cannot be undone once submitted, so it should be used with care.

decoys.name: strikeSet
decoys.desc: Permanently strikes a show run's set from the stage, sending the scenery off to be scrapped. This action cannot be undone once submitted, so it should be used with care.

decoys.name: releaseRights
decoys.desc: Permanently releases a show run's licensing rights back to the publisher, ending the company's claim to the title. This action cannot be undone once submitted, so it should be used with care.

set_enum.name: setProductionPhase
set_enum.desc: Advances or reverts a show run's production phase among rehearsal, previews, open run, and closed. Stage management uses this to record where a production actually stands.

decoys.name: setTourPhase
decoys.desc: Advances or reverts a show run's touring phase among rehearsal, previews, open run, and closed. The road manager uses this to record where the touring company stands.

decoys.name: setTransferPhase
decoys.desc: Advances or reverts a show run's transfer phase among rehearsal, previews, open run, and closed. Producers use this to record where a move to a larger house stands.

decoys.name: setMarketingPhase
decoys.desc: Advances or reverts a show run's marketing phase among rehearsal, previews, open run, and closed. The press office uses this to record which campaign stage is running.

set_bool.name: setUnderstudy
set_bool.desc: Marks a show run as having a ready understudy, meaning a trained cover can step in for any lead. Stage management relies on this flag when making last-minute casting calls.

decoys.name: setRelaxed
decoys.desc: Marks a show run as a relaxed performance, meaning house lights stay up and audience noise is welcome. Front of house relies on this flag when briefing the ushers.

decoys.name: setCaptioned
decoys.desc: Marks a show run as captioned, meaning open captions are displayed beside the stage. Front of house relies on this flag when seating hard-of-hearing patrons.

decoys.name: setSellout
decoys.desc: Marks a show run as a sellout, meaning the box office has released its last seats. Front of house relies on this flag when running the returns queue.

set_ref.name: reassignProducer
set_ref.desc: Transfers a show run from one producer's slate to another's, updating the credited producer of record. This is typically used when a run changes hands mid-season.

decoys.name: licenseProducer
decoys.desc: Licenses a show run from the company's slate to another producer, granting them rights to stage it elsewhere. This is typically used when a regional house picks up the production.

decoys.name: pitchProducer
decoys.desc: Pitches a show run from the company's slate to another producer, sending them the script and budget. This is typically used when seeking a partner for a transfer.

decoys.name: billProducer
decoys.desc: Bills a show run's weekly costs from the company's books to another producer, updating who pays the running costs. This is typically used when a partner takes on a share of the budget.

send.name: ringProducer
send.desc: Places a call to the producer associated with a given show run, or to a named producer directly. This is the company's standard way of relaying urgent scheduling news.

decoys.name: emailProducer
decoys.desc: Sends an email to the producer associated with a given show run, or to a named producer directly. This is the company's standard way of sharing weekly box office reports.
child_verbs: send the producer behind {obj} an email

decoys.name: memoProducer
decoys.desc: Sends a written memo to the producer associated with a given show run, or to a named producer directly. This is the company's standard way of recording formal notes on a production.
child_verbs: send a memo to the producer of {obj}

decoys.name: compProducer
decoys.desc: Sends complimentary tickets to the producer associated with a given show run, or to a named producer directly. This is the company's standard way of inviting them to a performance.
child_verbs: send comps to the producer of {obj}
invite the producer behind {obj} to a performance

create.name: createRun
create.desc: Creates a new show run for a producer, with an optional show title and starting phase. Use this when a production is added to the company's season.

decoys.name: createReading
decoys.desc: Creates a new staged reading for a producer, with an optional show title and starting phase. Use this when a new script gets a one-night workshop.

decoys.name: createTour
decoys.desc: Creates a new tour leg for a producer, with an optional show title and starting phase. Use this when a production is booked to go on the road.

decoys.name: createBenefit
decoys.desc: Creates a new benefit gala for a producer, with an optional show title and starting phase. Use this when the development office stages a fundraising night.

list_notes.name: lsRunNotes
list_notes.desc: Returns the notes attached to a single show run. It includes every remark the company has logged against that production.

decoys.name: lsRunReports
decoys.desc: Returns the performance reports attached to a single show run. It includes every nightly report stage management has filed on that production.

decoys.name: lsRunCues
decoys.desc: Returns the cue sheets attached to a single show run. It includes every lighting and sound cue called during that production.

decoys.name: lsRunReviews
decoys.desc: Returns the press reviews attached to a single show run. It includes every critic's write-up logged against that production.

add_note.name: addRunNote
add_note.desc: Attaches a new note to a show run, with an optional title. Use this to record remarks from the company about the production.

decoys.name: addRunReport
decoys.desc: Attaches a new performance report to a show run, with an optional title. Use this to record how a night's show went for stage management.

decoys.name: addRunCue
decoys.desc: Attaches a new cue sheet to a show run, with an optional title. Use this to record a lighting or sound cue for the production.

decoys.name: addRunReview
decoys.desc: Attaches a new press review to a show run, with an optional title. Use this to record a critic's write-up of the production.

update_note.name: editRunNote
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a show run. Use this to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: editRunReport
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing performance report on a show run. Use this to add late details to a night's report.

decoys.name: editRunCue
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing cue sheet on a show run. Use this to adjust a cue after a technical rehearsal.

decoys.name: editRunReview
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing press review on a show run. Use this to fix a quote or byline after it has been logged.

delete_note.name: rmRunNote
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a note from a show run. The remark is erased from the company's records for good.

decoys.name: rmRunReport
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a performance report from a show run. The report is erased from the company's records for good.

decoys.name: rmRunCue
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a cue sheet from a show run. The cue is erased from the company's records for good.

decoys.name: rmRunReview
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a press review from a show run. The review is erased from the company's records for good.

set_image.name: setRunImage
set_image.desc: Sets the image shown on a show run record. It is typically a production still taken at the dress rehearsal.

decoys.name: setRunPoster
decoys.desc: Sets the key art poster shown on a show run record. It is typically the artwork from the marketing campaign.

decoys.name: setRunGroundplan
decoys.desc: Sets the ground plan shown on a show run record. It is typically the set designer's overhead drawing of the stage.

decoys.name: setRunSeatmap
decoys.desc: Sets the seating map shown on a show run record. It is typically the house plan used by the box office.

writer.name: writeMessage
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the show runs it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeProgram
decoys.desc: Writes a program note from a brief, which states the theme in the dramaturg's own words, and the show runs it should cover. It returns the finished note.

decoys.name: writeRelease
decoys.desc: Writes a press release from a brief, which states the news in the press officer's own words, and the show runs it should announce. It returns the finished release.

decoys.name: writeNarrative
decoys.desc: Writes a grant narrative from a brief, which states the case in the development director's own words, and the show runs it should cite. It returns the finished narrative.

image.name: generateImage
image.desc: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generateModel
decoys.desc: Generates a set model rendering from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generateTrailer
decoys.desc: Generates a short video trailer from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: findPhoto
decoys.desc: Finds a matching photo in the company's production archive for a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the match.

search.name: searchDocs
search.desc: Searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the company's systems work.

decoys.name: searchScripts
decoys.desc: Searches the licensed scripts with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a line or stage direction.

decoys.name: searchRulebook
decoys.desc: Searches the Equity rulebook with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a union work rule.

decoys.name: searchPromptbooks
decoys.desc: Searches the stage management prompt books with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a blocking or cue decision.
